cohort: 206 neonates with sepsis admitted to TASH Hospital, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia from September 2018 to September 2020
finding: Lower birth weight, presence of neurologic features, presence of comorbidity, presence of drug therapy problems and male sex were predictors of a longer hospital stay among neonates with sepsis.
mod_finding: While mean length of stay was shorter among neonates born to mothers with PROM and CS delivery, these factors were not significant predictors of prolonged hospitalization.
birth_weight: Low birth weight associated with longer hospital stay
